Welcome to Beastly – the new, all-action channel formerly known as Barcroft Animals. Every week Beastly will bring you the biggest, scariest creatures on the planet – from lions to leopards, pitbulls to pythons; from apex predators snapped in the wild, to the ferocious beasts some people call pets in the home. Beastly will be the home of hit shows like Dog Dynasty and Beast Buddies, and will celebrate the new breed of young conservationists putting animals – and the planet – first. For the very biggest, and best, in animals, adventure and the environment visit Beastly – the channel that puts the king in animal kingdom.

For licensing and archive requests, please email the licensing team: licensing-archive@futurenet.com 

All our music comes from www.epidemicsound.com
